combat.scope: Every actual population spawn, 2,400 update ticks, moving player target, nonlethal on_hit at tick700, live projectile motion/cancellation and FX RNG sampled every tick. Existing archetypes, seed positions, and model APIs preserved. Does not include death (separate skin/capacity test).

lighting.scope: 16 scene light passes across all four zones. Exact current immutable library; material/emission/actor/water/point-list preservation asserted in each. Quiet-versus-off protected masks include native cells, actors, nonreceivers, sky. Bloomwild weather intentionally modulates lighting, so its protected hash may differ. Pure court receiver runs current pinned cinder_floor.rs in Rect adapter for all native points.

controlled_point_fixture.scope: Same 16 scenes with additional transient cyan point emitter (170px radius, intensity0.85), to exercise shadow receivers where the still scene has no remote emitter.

checks: Actual live lobbed imp seeds removed with warning lifetime.
Wisp released bolts retain existing behavior.
Unrelated active projectile stays exactly unchanged.

inspection: Reference uses original atlas pose under restored thread-local skin guard, no changes to enemy state.
Reference receives independent FX buffers and cloned projectiles; real death callback runs once against actual shared game context.
Reference preserves the current starting FX RNG and tick, then only resulting RNG is copied back.
Death callbacks create no shared hit IDs or gameplay hits; scratch hits, sounds, flash and trauma are discarded.
Reference uses empty visual capacity so culling cannot alter subsequent combat RNG.
death_rng_review.root_test_scope: 6 kinds × 3 skins × 2 phases × 2 particle capacities, 64 following RNG values and projectile state per case.

clustered_death_timing.scope: Selected immutable library, CPU-quiet window granted by root after record/audio/encoding finished. Wall time for lethal on_hit batches only; updates/setup excluded; 96 samples per case. Species vary across 3/6/18-death clusters at deterministic skin coordinates. Includes scratch canonical death, actual skin debris, active projectile cloning/cancellation, and capacity stress.
clustered_death_timing.limit: Microbenchmark of death work, not whole-frame or browser timing. Root Cinder whole-render log separately passes its 8 ms budget.

limitations: No artistic approval or completeness claim for all campaign frames; independent visual reviewers own that.

Exact round5 enemy parity covers updates/projectiles/nonlethal damage before death. Post-death RNG now deliberately uses canonical original-pose progression instead of the previous skin/capacity coupling.
The whole renderer and unit-suite results were run by root and inspected here, not rerun by this reviewer.
No Cua, GUI, subjective audio audition, browser runtime, or GPU testing.
